definitions.gloss: to recall; to remember; to bring to mind
definitions.explanation: To consciously remember or call up a memory, image, or thought from the past.

definitions.gloss: to imagine; to picture; to visualize
definitions.explanation: To form a mental image of something, whether real or imaginary.

notes:
- {思|おも}い{浮|う}かべる → {思|おも}い{浮|う}かべない (negative)
- {思|おも}い{浮|う}かべる → {思|おも}い{浮|う}かべて (te-form)
- {思|おも}い{浮|う}かべる → {思|おも}い{浮|う}かべた (past)

FORMS:
Compound verb: ⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (to think) + ⟦{浮|う}かべる→浮かべる：13314_ukaberu⟧ (to float, to bring to surface)

The image of "floating" a thought or memory to the surface of consciousness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{浮|う}かべる - to picture someone's face
- ⟦{思|おも}い{出|で}→思い出：00331_omoide⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{浮|う}かべる - to recall memories
- ⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{浮|う}かべる - to picture a scene
- ⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{浮|う}かべる - to envision the future

TRANSITIVITY:
- ⟦{思|おも}い{浮|う}かぶ→思い浮かぶ：07603_omoiukabu⟧ (intransitive) - to come to mind, to occur to
